narrative_checks: A concrete order connects paired evaluation, routing, reusable logs, ancestry, forecasts, simulation and work.
Arena direct preference, AlpacaEval automatic judgment, checked truth and useful work kept distinct.
RouteLLM and FrugalGPT offer substantive positive cost/performance cases with dated boundaries.
Yahoo logged-data evaluation is a constructive counterweight to blanket unknowability.
Blackwell–Dubins and Zhang credited; no theorem about chatbot truth or universal attribution failure.
Smallville party/Adam Smith are clearly software simulation events, not invented human reporting.
AlphaEvolve adds executed evaluation and reported real operation; independent-audit and resource/energy distinction retained.
Cumulative chance outside current favorite remains distinct from scores, calls, market shares, model counts and welfare.
No equations, fabricated interviews, visits, actual-firm finite-budget estimate, policy tax rate or proof certification.
Verbosity example now supplies actual score range and explains the reference comparison without implying equal answer quality.
Logged-policy evaluation, history under unchanged response rules and training-policy intervention explicitly separated.
Removed repeated self-description of novelty and a generic activity summary; original predecessor credit remains.
whole_book_review: Current component revision reviewed for recorded claims. Comparative-institutions revision in Chapters10–12, four original canonical technical passages and final cross-book reconciliation remain open.

sequential_review.method: Complete body and all notes read after Chapter 7. New evaluation detail checked in original versioned paper; revised passages re-read with surrounding text. Earlier full-source records and explicit simulation/developer/version boundaries retained.
findings: Purchase-order task connects correctness, preference, routing, logs, model ancestry, simulation and later learning without invented workplace reporting.
Actual AlpacaEval prompt score swing replaces abstraction; reference response and preference-probability meaning explained, with quality-change/adjustment assumptions retained.
Arena human votes distinct from automatic judge, known-answer checking and representative workplace demand.
Router predicted preference distinct from actual conditional assignment chance; deterministic assignment can coexist with informative checked outcomes.
Yahoo logged-policy replay uses designed variation under conditions, not a structural replay of economic development.
Historical hiring variation now explicitly follows fixed response rules; deliberate training change is a separate intervention.
Shared ancestry does not imply identical outputs or independent research histories; all informative private tests count.
Blackwell–Dubins and Zhang retain predecessor credit; merging alone not universal nonlearning or chatbot truth.
Smallville is software simulation, AlphaEvolve developer-reported local evaluation; neither certifies a whole counterfactual economy or total contribution.
